answer: An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The atlas counter is kept in zephyr and river shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4693 identities would post 4433 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
